title: Four folding doors in the opening

options.name: The design
options.text: Four pine folding doors in two pairs, hung from a track at the room side of a new timber lining. The end door of each pair is hung on parliament hinges, so the folded pair swings right out of the opening and lies almost flat on the wall, past the architrave and skirting. Architrave goes round both sides of the opening.

poster.alt: 3D model of four pine folding doors in two pairs in a wide opening, folding back flat against the wall

notes: The opening width, height and wall thickness are measured.
The lining, the gaps round the doors, the door sizes, the architrave and the parliament hinges are standard sizes to start from.
The parliament hinges stand a little proud of the lining so the folded doors clear the architrave and skirting and sit almost flat on the wall.
The skirting and picture rail are made good on both sides of the wall where they meet the new opening.
Colours on screen are a guide.
